originalTitle: What different world maps get right - and what they get wrong
title: Amazing Maps: How Big is Our Africa, Really?
content:
Hello, Friends!

Hello, amazing young explorers! Your friendly news reporter from Africa is here! Today, we are going on a super fun adventure to learn about maps. Have you ever seen a world map? It's like a big picture of our whole Earth! Maps help us find places, like your school, your friend's house, or even far-away countries. They are super helpful tools, right? Well, guess what? Something very important is happening with world maps, especially for our amazing continent, Africa!

What is a Map?

Imagine you are flying high above the Earth, even higher than the birds! If you could take a picture of the ground below, that's a bit like what a map is. It's a drawing or picture of a place, showing us where everything is. Maps can show a small area, like your neighbourhood, or a very big area, like a whole country. Some maps are so big they show our entire planet! These are called world maps. Did you know? Maps are like secret guides that help us find our way from one place to another without getting lost!

Why Do We Use Maps?

Maps are used for so many cool things! When you go on a trip with your family, you might use a map to see which road to take. Teachers use maps to show you where different countries are in the world. Sailors use maps to sail their big boats across the ocean. Maps teach us about different countries, different animals, and different people all around the world. They help us learn about our planet and all the wonderful places in it. Did you know? The very first maps were drawn on walls or animal skins thousands of years ago!

Our Earth is a Giant Ball!

Now, here's a super important thing to remember: our Earth is not flat like a piece of paper! It's actually a giant, round ball, like an orange or a big football. We call this round shape a 'globe'. When astronauts go into space, they can see our beautiful blue Earth spinning like a big ball. This is very important when we talk about maps. Did you know? Our Earth is also called the 'Blue Planet' because so much of it is covered by big oceans!

The Map Problem: Round vs. Flat

So, if our Earth is a big round ball, how do we make a flat map? This is the tricky part! Imagine you have a beautiful orange. If you peel the orange, and then try to flatten the peel onto a table, what happens? The peel doesn't lie flat easily, does it? It might tear, or stretch, or some parts will look bigger or smaller than they really are. Making a flat map from a round Earth is a bit like that! Did you know? Map-makers call this problem 'map projection'. It's like trying to squash a balloon flat without popping it!

Old Maps Made Africa Look Small!

For many, many years, people used a world map called the 'Mercator map'. This map was very good for sailors because it helped them steer their ships in a straight line across the ocean. But it had a secret! The Mercator map made countries near the top and bottom of the world look much, much bigger than they actually are. And because of this, it made countries near the middle of the world, like our amazing Africa, look much smaller! Did you know? On the old Mercator map, Greenland (a cold place far north) looked as big as Africa, but Africa is actually 14 times bigger than Greenland! Wow, that's a big difference!

Africa is Super, Super Big!

This is the most exciting part! Many people didn't know how truly enormous Africa is because of those old maps. But Africa is HUGE! It's one of the biggest continents in the world. You could fit countries like the United States of America, China, India, Japan, and many countries in Europe all inside Africa! Imagine all those countries fitting inside our continent! That's how incredibly big Africa is. Africa has many different countries, different languages, and many different kinds of people. It has big deserts, huge forests, and amazing animals like elephants, giraffes, and lions. Did you know? Africa is home to 54 different countries, each with its own special culture and stories!

New Maps Show the True Story!

Good news! A very important group called the United Nations (they are like a big club for all the countries in the world) has decided to use a new kind of world map. This new map tries to show countries closer to their real size. This means that on the new maps, our beautiful Africa will finally look as big as it truly is! This is super important because it helps everyone understand the real size and importance of our continent. Did you know? The United Nations wants all countries to be treated fairly, and that includes showing their true size on world maps!

Why True Size Matters

Why is it so important that maps show Africa's real size? Well, if a map makes a place look small, people might think it's not very important or doesn't have many people or resources. But Africa is full of life, amazing people, and important natural treasures! When we see Africa in its true size, it helps us understand how many people live here, how much land there is for farming, and how big its forests and rivers are. It helps us appreciate Africa's big role in the world. It's about fairness and showing respect to all countries and all people on Earth. Every country deserves to be seen in its true light, not made smaller or bigger by a map. Did you know? Knowing the true size of countries helps us learn more about their history, their people, and their importance to the world!

Maps Help Us Learn!

So, maps are not just pieces of paper; they are powerful tools that teach us about our world. Now, when you see a world map, you'll know that Africa is not small, but a truly enormous and wonderful continent! Keep exploring, keep learning, and keep asking questions about our amazing planet. Maps are a great way to start your adventure! Your friendly reporter from Africa, signing off!

originalTitle: Susan Sarandon says she still loses film roles over support for Palestine
title: Our Voices Are Powerful: A Story About Susan Sarandon
content:
Hello, Friends!

Hello, super listeners and curious kids of Africa! It's your friendly news reporter here. Today, we have a very interesting story to share with you. It's about a grown-up lady who is very famous. She has a big heart and likes to speak up about things she believes in. Sometimes, speaking up can be a little bit tricky!

We are going to learn about a lady named Susan Sarandon. She is an actress, which means she pretends to be different people in movies. Her story helps us think about why it's good to use our voices, even when it's hard.

Who is Susan Sarandon?

Susan Sarandon is a wonderful actress from a country far away called America. She has been in many, many movies that grown-ups watch. You might not know her movies yet, but maybe your parents or older brothers and sisters do!

She is known for being kind and for caring a lot about people all over the world. She loves to help others and make sure everyone is treated fairly. She has a very strong voice and uses it to talk about important things.

Did you know? Actresses like Susan often spend many hours learning their lines and practicing how to act sad, happy, or brave! It's a lot of hard work, but also lots of fun to pretend!

What Are "Film Roles"?

When Susan Sarandon acts in a movie, she gets a "film role." A film role is like a special part she gets to play. Imagine you are playing a game of make-believe. You might pretend to be a brave lion, or a kind doctor, or a fast runner.

For an actress, a film role is a character she brings to life on the screen. She gets to dress up in different clothes, say different words, and show different feelings, all to tell a story. It's like magic how they can become someone else!

Did you know? The very first movies ever made didn't even have sound! People just watched the pictures move. Actors had to use big, clear movements to show what their characters were feeling!

Speaking Up for What You Believe

Now, here is the interesting part of our story. Susan Sarandon believes it's very important to speak up for people who might be having a hard time. She wants everyone to be safe and happy. There is a place far, far away, called Palestine.

Susan has shared her feelings about the people in Palestine. She wants to make sure people know about them and how important it is to be kind to everyone. She believes that everyone deserves to live in peace and have a good life.

Sometimes, when people talk about important things like this, not everyone agrees. Some people might have different ideas or feelings. But Susan feels it's so important that she chooses to share her thoughts anyway.

Did you know? In many parts of Africa, people use music and storytelling to share important messages and help others understand big ideas! It's a powerful way to speak up without using only words.

What Happens When You Speak Up?

So, what happens when Susan Sarandon speaks up about what she believes? Well, she says that sometimes, when she shares her strong feelings, she "loses film roles." This means that some people who make movies decide not to ask her to be in their films anymore.

Imagine if you really wanted to play in a game, but then someone said, "No, you can't play with us today," just because you said something they didn't like. That's a bit like what happens to Susan.

It can be sad and frustrating when you don't get to do something you love, especially if you think you are doing the right thing. But Susan still chooses to speak her mind, because she feels it's more important to stand up for others.

Did you know? Even though she might lose some roles, Susan is still a very famous and loved actress. Many people admire her for being brave and honest, even when it's hard!

Why This Is Important For Us

Why is Susan's story important for you, our young friends in Africa? It teaches us a big lesson about our voices. Each one of you has a voice. It means you can share your thoughts, your ideas, and your feelings.

When you see something that isn't fair, or when you want to help a friend, your voice is a powerful tool. You can speak up in class, or tell your parents, or talk to your friends. It takes courage to do this sometimes.

Just like Susan, we might find that not everyone agrees with us when we speak up. But if you truly believe in something kind and good, it's always important to use your voice. You can make a difference!

Did you know? Many heroes from Africa's history, like Nelson Mandela, used their voices to fight for fairness and freedom for everyone. Their voices changed the world!

Our Voices Matter

Every single voice, even a small one, can make a difference. When you are kind to a friend, or share your toys, or stand up for someone who is being teased, you are using your voice in a positive way.

Susan Sarandon's story reminds us that it's good to think about what is fair and right. And then, it's good to be brave enough to talk about it. Maybe you won't lose a film role, but you might gain a stronger heart!

Remember, speaking up doesn't always mean shouting. It can be a quiet word, a gentle explanation, or even just being a good example for others to follow. Your voice is a gift!

Let's Learn and Grow!

So, dear friends, next time you see something that makes you think, or if you want to help someone, remember Susan Sarandon. Remember how she uses her voice for what she believes is right. You can do that too!

Keep being curious, keep learning, and keep using your kind, powerful voices. We are so proud of you, and we believe in you! See you next time for more news from Africa and around the world!
summary: Susan Sarandon, a famous actress, sometimes loses movie roles because she bravely speaks up about her beliefs, teaching us that using our voices can have consequences but is still important.
whyMatters: This story matters because it shows us that everyone has a voice, and it's brave to use it for what you believe is right, even if it's hard or others don't agree.

originalTitle: Two right-backs in midfield - are Chelsea short despite £349m spent?
title: Fun with Football: What Happened with Chelsea?
content:
Hello, Football Friends!

Hello, amazing young friends! It's your super-duper news reporter from Africa, ready to tell you about exciting things happening in the world of football. Do you love watching football? Kicking a ball with your friends? It's one of the best games ever! Today, we are going to talk about a famous football team called Chelsea. Chelsea is a big team from a country far away. They wear blue shirts. They play against other big teams. Sometimes they win, and sometimes they lose. That's just how sports are, right? We always try our best, even if we don't win every time. Trying is the most important part! Did you know? Football is the most popular sport in the whole wide world! Many children in Africa love to play football, just like you!

What Happened in the Big Game?

Last Sunday, Chelsea played a very important game. They played against another strong team called Arsenal. Both teams wanted to win very much! They ran, they kicked, they passed the ball. It was a very exciting match to watch. But guess what? Chelsea lost the game. Arsenal won 2-1. That means Arsenal scored 2 goals, and Chelsea scored 1 goal. Losing can feel a bit sad, but it's also a chance to learn and get better for next time. Every team learns from its games. This game made some people wonder about Chelsea. They started asking big questions about the team. Let's find out why!

Meet the Players and Their Jobs!

Imagine a football field. It's like a big green carpet! On this carpet, there are many players. Each player has a special job. It's like in your classroom, some friends are good at drawing, and some are good at counting. Everyone has a special role to play in the team. Some players are called 'goalkeepers'. Their job is to stop the ball from going into the net. They wear big gloves! Other players are 'defenders'. They help the goalkeeper protect the goal. They play near their own goal. Then there are 'midfielders'. They play in the middle of the field. They help get the ball from the defenders to the players who score goals. They run a lot, from one side of the field to the other. And some players are called 'strikers'. Their main job is to score goals! It's super fun to watch them kick the ball into the net. So, every player has a special place and a special job on the team. This helps everyone know what to do. Did you know? There are 11 players on a football team when they play a match! Each player wears a different numbered shirt, so we know who they are.

When Players Play New Jobs

Now, here is the interesting part about the Chelsea game. Usually, players stick to their jobs. But in this game, something a little bit unusual happened. When the game was ending, Chelsea had two players who are usually 'right-backs' playing in the 'midfield'. What is a 'right-back'? A 'right-back' is a defender. Their usual job is to play on the right side of the field. They try to stop the other team from scoring goals from that side. They are good at defending their goal. What is 'midfield'? The 'midfield' is the middle part of the field. Midfielders need to run a lot and pass the ball to everyone. They help attack and defend. Their job is very different from a 'right-back'. So, imagine asking your friend who is super good at drawing to suddenly lead the counting game. It's not their usual job! These two right-backs were trying their best, but playing in a different spot can be tricky. It's like wearing your shoes on the wrong feet – you can still walk, but it might feel a bit funny! They are good players, but playing a different job is hard. It can make the team work a little differently than usual. This is why people noticed it so much!

Why is This a Big Deal?

Why is it important if players play in new jobs? Well, every player practices a lot for their special job. They know exactly where to run and what to do. When they play in a different spot, it's harder for them. They might not know the best places to be or the best passes to make. It's like building a tower of blocks. If you have special blocks for the bottom and special blocks for the top, it works best. If you mix them up, the tower might not be as strong. In football, if players are not in their usual spots, the team might not be as strong together. This made many people wonder: Does Chelsea have enough players for all the different jobs? Even though they have many players, maybe they didn't have enough midfielders ready to play that day. Or maybe they wanted to try something new, but it didn't work out as they hoped. Teamwork is so important! When everyone knows their job and does it well, the team is stronger. It helps them win games and have more fun.

Buying New Friends for the Team

Chelsea is a very rich team. They have spent a lot, a lot, a lot of money to buy new players. We are talking about hundreds of millions of pounds! That's like having many, many, many bags of money. Imagine that! They buy players from all over the world. When a team buys new players, it's like welcoming new friends to your group. You hope they will help your team become even better. These new players come from different teams and countries. They bring new skills and ideas to the team. It's usually a good thing to get new players. But even after spending so much money, people were still asking, "Do Chelsea have all the right players in all the right places?" Sometimes having lots of players doesn't mean you have the perfect player for every single job, especially when some players get tired or hurt during a game. Did you know? Some famous African football players like Didier Drogba used to play for Chelsea! He was a super goal scorer and helped Chelsea win many games!

Learning from the Game

So, what can we learn from this? We learn that in football, just like in life, teamwork is super important. Everyone needs to work together. And everyone needs to know their job and do their best in it. If someone is out of place, it can make things harder for everyone. Even big teams like Chelsea have challenges. They have to think hard about who plays where and how they can play their best. It's all about trying different things and learning from them. Every game is a lesson, whether you win or lose. Sometimes, even with lots of money, a team still has to figure out the best way for all their players to play together. It's like finding the right puzzle pieces to make a beautiful picture.

Always Try Your Best!

So, next time you are playing football with your friends, remember the Chelsea story! Try your best in your position. Help your friends. And always remember that learning and having fun are the most important parts of any game. It's okay to try new things, but it's also important to be ready for your usual job. Keep playing, keep smiling, and keep learning, my wonderful friends! This is your news reporter signing off. See you next time for more fun news!
summary: Chelsea, a famous football team, lost a game where some players had to play in unusual positions, making people wonder if they have enough of the right players despite spending a lot of money.
whyMatters: This matters because in football, just like in any team game, everyone doing their special job in their special spot helps the team work best together to win and have fun.
